fullPassage: There's a saying that "you can't eat information." That may be so, but the food we eat today is the fruit of thousands of years of increasingly high-quality information — the knowledge of how to farm — what seeds, what tools and how to use them, what times of year, what irrigation, what sequence of one crop after another on the same land. What we eat is solar energy, filtered, concentrated, and distilled through the lens of human knowledge. The energy the Earth receives from the sun each year has remained more or less constant through all of human civilization. What's allowed us to flourish is our increasingly sophisticated knowledge of how to capture an ever-growing but still tiny fraction of that energy in a form that can fuel our bodies. Every step in the advancement of our knowledge has brought with it an increase in the amount of energy we can tap into.

태양 에너지가 증가하면서 인류가 번영하게 되었다.

det.ref: 전체 지문
det.correct: ③ 'Every step in the advancement of our knowledge has brought with it an increase in energy' → 지식이 계속 발전하면 에너지 활용도 계속 증가할 것
wrongs: ② ❌ — fruit of knowledge = 지식 발전이 생산 증가
④ ❌ — 에너지는 constant, 지식이 핵심 변수
det.tip: 지식의 각 단계마다 에너지 증가 → 미래 지식 발전 → 더 많은 에너지 활용 추론 가능

questions.passage: There's a saying that "you can't eat information." That may be so, but the food we eat today is the fruit of thousands of years of increasingly high-quality information — the knowledge of how to farm — what seeds, what tools and how to use them, what times of year, what irrigation, what sequence of one crop after another on the same land. What we eat is solar energy, filtered, concentrated, and distilled through the lens of human knowledge. The energy the Earth receives from the sun each year has remained more or less constant through all of human civilization. What's allowed us to flourish is our increasingly sophisticated knowledge of how to capture an ever-growing but still tiny fraction of that energy in a form that can fuel our bodies. Every step in the advancement of our knowledge has brought with it an increase in the amount of energy we can tap into.
questions.stem: 윗글에 따르면, 인류가 번영할 수 있게 해 준 것은 무엇인가? 영어로 쓰시오. (원문 기준 3단어)

det.ref: [원문] What's allowed us to flourish is our increasingly sophisticated knowledge
det.correct: our sophisticated knowledge: 우리의 정교한 지식
det.tip: What's allowed us to flourish = ~한 것은 우리의 점점 더 정교한 지식

윗글을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸에 적절한 것은?

Although solar energy has remained (A) , humanity has (B) by developing knowledge to harness more of it.

det.ref: 전체 지문
det.correct: ② constant + flourished: 태양 에너지는 일정하지만, 인류는 지식 발전으로 번영
det.tip: constant(일정) + flourished(번영) = 글의 핵심 요약
